name: resumeflow
idea: ResumeFlow is a free, browser-only resume builder that lets job seekers create polished, ATS-friendly PDF resumes in minutes with live preview, multiple templates, and 8 color themes — no signup, no watermarks, no backend required.
why_trending: 'Free resume builder' sustains millions of monthly searches in 2026; AI-driven job market disruption is accelerating workforce transitions globally, keeping resume creation demand at an all-time high per Google Trends and Reddit r/jobs discussions in May 2026. Zety and Resume.io each see 10M+ monthly visitors.
why_profitable: Competitors Resume.io, Zety, and Novoresume charge $2–40/month; free tools monetize via display ads (high-CPC career/job keywords at $3–8 CPM), premium template unlocks ($5–9 one-time), and affiliate links to LinkedIn Premium and job boards (Indeed, ZipRecruiter).
why_easy: 100% static HTML/CSS/JS — jsPDF handles all PDF generation client-side via CDN, localStorage persists the resume between sessions with zero server calls. Two layout templates, 8 accent colors, and 5 section types all driven by a single 774-line file. Deployable on GitHub Pages or Netlify at zero cost.
